headings.style: Radical weight contrast (Black vs Light). Do not use Inter for headings.

body.style: Clean geometric body for max legibility.

colors.archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Linear Style)
colors.theme: Dark Mode Default with High Impact Minimalist aesthetics.
colors.rules: No generic full-screen gradients. Tint neutral greys with a slight blue/cool tone. Never use pure black #000000. Text must meet APCA standards.

visual enhancers.glassmorphism: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] (The Crystal variant)
visual enhancers.borders: 1px solid stroke (border-white/10) to define sections. Remove soft shadows in dark mode, use inner glows.
visual enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise/grain overlay div covering the background.
visual enhancers.tracing_beam: Use on high-conversion cards (Pricing) with shimmering borders.

component name.strategy: Shadcn UI base, heavily customized for Linear/SaaS aesthetic.
component name.button: Sharp rectangular or fully pill-shaped. Primary uses pure white bg with black text, or accent blue.
component name.card: Cardless or max 8px border-radius. Use 'Grid Borders' approach.
component name.form: Shadcn Form elements. Never native inputs.

grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (Data Correlation). Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap: tight (gap-4).
grids.marketing: The Bento Grid Protocol (Tetris style) for features. Asymmetric spans (col-span-8, col-span-4). Wide gaps (gap-8).

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.
layouts.hero: One-column layout, massive H1, sticky CTA, glassmorphic header.
layouts.pricing: Linear-style one column flow with 3 distinct card tiers and a clean monthly/annual toggle.
layouts.dashboard_sidebar: Sticky left sidebar (w-64), solid background, subtle right border.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must lift (-translate-y-1) or alter border color (border-white/30).
motion.technical: Use explicit transitions: transition-transform transition-colors duration-200 ease-out. Exclude transforms from universal transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. NEVER rely on inheritance for hover states.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus states: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500.

media.strategy: Limit photography to essential moments (testimonials/interviews). Rely on typographic hierarchy and geometry for visual interest.
media.overlay: If images are used in backgrounds, apply bg-black/60 to ensure text readability.

3d libraries.recommendation: Use TSParticles for a subtle floating mesh network background in the hero section to simulate AI capability. Keep it low opacity (10%).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React (.js/.jsx) + Tailwind CSS. DO NOT USE Typescript (.ts/.tsx).
Apply dark theme explicitly or by wrapping the main layout in a .dark class container.
Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for all icons and mock company logos.
Implement the layout with pure Tailwind CSS grid and flex utilities. Do not center everything. Left-align text for readability.
Ensure the dashboard features an ATS Resume Checker, Interview Prep, and Resume Builder per requirements.
Use Framer Motion for entrance animations (lazy-loaded to keep bundle size low).
For the Landing page pricing section, use a clean 3-tier Linear-style card layout with a monthly/annual toggle.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based) for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.

Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use typographic logos instead if images are not provided.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
